cases.summary: Grandson arrested, needs bail in gift cards, don't tell mom

input.visibleText: Grandma, it's me. I was in an accident and need bail money. Please buy gift cards and don't tell mom.

reasons.explanation: It mentions gift cards, wire transfers, or crypto. Scammers ask for these because the money can't be gotten back.
It asks you to keep a secret. Real family and real companies don't ask that.
It says a family member is in trouble and needs help fast. Call that person directly using a phone number you already have.

cases.why: A family emergency, gift cards, and secrecy.

reasons.explanation: It asks you to keep a secret. Real family and real companies don't ask that.
It says a family member is in trouble and needs help fast. Call that person directly using a phone number you already have.

cases.summary: "Hi Mom, new number, can you send money today"

input.visibleText: Hi Mom, I dropped my phone in the sink, this is my new number. Can you send $900 for a bill today? I'll pay you back.

reasons.explanation: It says a family member is in trouble and needs help fast. Call that person directly using a phone number you already have.
It asks you to pay or send money.

cases.why: A "new number" plus a money request: check by calling the number you already have.

cases.summary: Grandchild thanks grandma for birthday money

input.visibleText: Grandma, thank you so much for the birthday money! I bought a new book. Love you!

cases.summary: Grandchild mentions a small accident, asks for nothing

cases.summary: Family member asks for a recipe

input.visibleText: Mom, can you send me the soup recipe? The kids loved it.
